title: Precision Microbiota Interventions for Senoreduction Trial
official: Geroprotective Precision Medicine Strategies in PWH That Use Alcohol
summary: People with HIV who drink alcohol are at increased risk for accelerated aging biology, including increased immune senescence. This randomized, double-blind, crossover clinical trial evaluates two generally recognized as safe (GRAS) microbiota-targeted interventions on immune senescence biomarkers.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥40 years
* People with HIV
* Recent alcohol use defined as ≥42 grams in the prior week and positive urine ethyl glucuronide (EtG)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Probiotic use in past 3 months
* Recent antibiotics or immunosuppressives
* Allergy to study products
* Pregnancy or breastfeeding
* Inability to comply
